short: A response that lags and retains its past.
note: The dependence of a physical system on its previous states, often apparent as a lag in its response. Magnetic materials can retain magnetization after the applied field changes.
A bistable circuit can remain in either of two stable states, a basic arrangement used in electronic switching and memory.
